address: # Names for 3.1.9 (VA = 0x08040000 + file offset). Comment prefix "data;" makes a label instead of a function.

name: defaultTask
comment: UI task: input -> App vtbl+8 -> draw loop

name: pcmStreamer_loop
comment: SD streaming task; runs preset_cmd_dispatch (all preset file I/O)

name: ff_move_window
comment: loads a sector into fs->win (shared by all files: FF_FS_TINY)

name: SDMgr_CheckMount
comment: remounts when the card changed; +0x15 mounted flag

name: SDMgr_ListDirs
comment: directory walk used only by clean/delete; never patch

name: PresetMgr_Load
comment: cmd 0x22: TryLoad(name); on failure loads the first list row that works

name: PresetMgr_TryLoad
comment: preset.xml via doc_open; legacy root <name>.xml is migrated (writes!)

name: preset_xml_path
comment: joins preset.xml onto the preset folder

name: PresetMgr_RequestList
comment: UI side; posts cmd 0x10 with +0x394 current name

name: PresetMgr_RequestLoad
comment: cmd 0x22; rejects when +0x390 pending is set

name: settings_load
comment: startup settings.tml loader; auto-loads last preset

name: BitmapFile_SaveToFile
comment: screenshot; the only stock FatFs use in the UI task

name: ui_draw_cstring
comment: draws a C string on the panel

name: preset_screen_key
comment: preset screen key handler; case 0x18 = Load

name: ui_post_event_up
comment: posts an event up the widget tree

name: engine_obj
comment: data; audio engine / file queue owner

name: shared_FIL_ptr
comment: data; global FIL pointer (firmware memsets 0x58 bytes)

name: str_reset
comment: posters call it on staging strings +8/+0xC before str_assign

name: streamer_wake
comment: thunk to 0x080711E0; posters call it with the engine object

name: App_HandleUiEvent
comment: UI event handler; case 0x18/0xD8 = preset Load button (LoadBank flag 1 + screen 2)

name: Param_RegisterAll
comment: 500 x 0x1C slots; pointer 0x2401F4FC; last stock id 0x19B

name: InfoPage_Build
comment: walks ushort id tables; page stride 0x48

name: ClipPosSlot5_type4c
comment: data; zero; fifth Pos id on the type-0x4C Clip copy

name: ClipPosSlot5
comment: data; zero; fifth Pos id on a Clip pad (0x19C in 3.1.W)

name: SlicerPosSlot8
comment: data; zero; eighth Pos id on a Slicer pad (0x19C in 3.1.W)

name: SlicerPosSlot8_type4c
comment: data; zero; eighth Pos id on the type-0x4C Slicer copy

name: Clip_ctor
comment: type-0x4C Clip/Slicer engine; malloc 3000 (0xBB8); stock through +0xBB0

name: Clip_ApplyParam
comment: msg 0x39; cellmode 0x8B sets +0x29 and slicer flag +0x254

name: App_HandleInput
comment: hardware buttons; MIX bl App_SetScreen at 0x080A32DE; INFO on Mix at 0x080A30DC

name: Mix_ctor
comment: Mix/Mute widget; vtable 0x080F0F10; mode +0x1E40; selected pad +0x1E08

name: Container_Tick
comment: calls the active screen tick with flags

name: Widget_SetRect
comment: generic; reads the rect with LDM

name: ButtonBar_ctor
comment: up to 5 frame buttons at +0x3C + i*0xA0

name: Fader_SetValue
comment: bar rect from min/max and height

name: ScrollList_ctor
comment: rows in scroll view FUN_080C5700; selected row +0x986C

name: ScrollList_EncoderValue
comment: lower encoders: change the selected row

name: ScrollList_SelectRow
comment: also from a row tap (child event 0x145)

name: EQPage_Layout
comment: on 0xD4; graph rect on the stack

name: Seq_RecordNote
comment: note ring entry -> sequence event (gate App+0x8CC1 == 1)

name: SE_AdvanceClock
comment: SE+0x00 samples always; SE+0x30 ticks while playing

name: Midi_UsbPacketsIn
comment: USB-MIDI packets -> manager ring +0x4660 (map-319 MIDI note path)

name: Pcm_PollMidi
comment: MIDI events -> engine msgs 5/6/7/8/9/0xB/0xC via router 0x400

name: MidiMap_PadNoteOn
comment: builds pad event type 2 (+4 offset +8 key +0xC note +0x10 vel) or 0x18 for idx >= 20

name: MidiMap_RebuildChannels
comment: node+0x334[16] channel roles: 1 pad MIDI In; 2 Global In; 3 Keys; 4 Seq

name: MidiMap_NoteOn
comment: msg 5: pad MIDI In channel passes the note; Global In padnote/default map pass note 0

name: MidiMap_Process
comment: MIDI map node: tbh on msg type - 5; per-pad rows node+0x24+12*idx (midimode; padnote; key)

name: Clip_VoiceStart
comment: (clip; transport; offset; note; [sp] velocity; [sp+4] router); 3.1.E hook_voice

name: Clip_Process
comment: per-pad event loop of the Clip/Slicer engine object

name: Param_BagAlloc
comment: (bag; n rows) allocates n*8 once; capacity at +0xC; 3.1.E hook_bag_size 64->96

name: Wave_Draw
comment: (wave; ctx) waveform widget draw; vtable 0x080F1968; 3.1.E deck_wave_draw

name: Wave_Tick
comment: waveform widget tick: scroll/playhead follow; applies zoom target wave+0x24C
